 pause=SpendPause(); active=pause.is_active()
 key=wmill.get_variable('u/Alp/OPENROUTER_API_KEY')
 r=requests.get('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/key',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+key},timeout=20);r.raise_for_status();k=r.json()['data']
 return {'titles':output,'pause_active':active,'pause_ttl':pause.redis.ttl(PAUSE_KEY),'key':{k1:k.get(k1) for k1 in ['limit','limit_reset','limit_remaining','usage','usage_daily','usage_monthly']}}
